title: Breakfast in November
setting: A cozy cafe on a cold November morning.

characters.name: Emma
characters.look: Emma, a girl with short brown hair and a friendly smile

characters.name: Rosa
characters.look: Rosa, a girl with long black hair and glasses

sentences.en: In November, Emma and Rosa meet at a cafe.
sentences.zh: 十一月，艾玛和罗莎在一家咖啡馆见面。
sentences.scene_prompt: Emma, a girl with short brown hair and a friendly smile and Rosa, a girl with long black hair and glasses meet at the door of a cozy cafe on a cold day.

sentences.en: Emma wears a yellow dress and a warm jacket.
sentences.zh: 艾玛穿着一条黄色连衣裙和一件暖和的外套。
sentences.scene_prompt: Emma, a girl with short brown hair and a friendly smile in a yellow dress and a warm jacket stands inside the cafe.

sentences.en: They have a quick breakfast at a small table.
sentences.zh: 她们在一张小桌旁匆匆吃了早餐。
sentences.scene_prompt: Emma, a girl with short brown hair and a friendly smile and Rosa, a girl with long black hair and glasses eat a quick breakfast of bread and coffee at a small cafe table.

sentences.en: Rosa asks Emma about her trip in August.
sentences.zh: 罗莎问艾玛八月的旅行怎么样。
sentences.scene_prompt: Rosa, a girl with long black hair and glasses leans forward and asks Emma, a girl with short brown hair and a friendly smile a question across the table.

sentences.en: Her grandma lives in a place by the sea.
sentences.zh: 她的奶奶住在海边的一个地方。
sentences.scene_prompt: A small house in a place by the sea, with an old woman waving at the door.

sentences.en: Emma stayed there for four happy weeks.
sentences.zh: 艾玛在那里度过了快乐的四个星期。
sentences.scene_prompt: Emma, a girl with short brown hair and a friendly smile remembers a sunny beach day, smiling at the table.

sentences.en: Then Emma takes her bag to catch a bus.
sentences.zh: 然后艾玛拿起包去赶公交车。
sentences.scene_prompt: Emma, a girl with short brown hair and a friendly smile picks up her bag and hurries out of the cafe toward a bus, Rosa, a girl with long black hair and glasses waving.
